rig.name: G40_BOUNDED_DIAGNOSTIC_RIG
rig.scope: Disposable biped-and-tail stress skeleton for topology and gross deformation screening. It has no animator controls, facial system, production constraints, corrective shapes, or authored production weights.

reach_tray_hold.intent: Both arms reach forward and inward to stress shoulder and armpit routing.

squat.intent: Lower the axial body 4.5 cm and flex hips/knees to stress groin and knee transitions.

walk_extreme.intent: Opposed exaggerated arm/leg stride at the intended mobile-game motion envelope.

tail_bend.intent: Five-bone lateral tail curl with mild lift.

verdict.statement: This run exercises a disposable bounded diagnostic rig. Passing metrics would not approve production topology, final weights, animation quality, art direction, or visual fidelity.
